hero.desktopTitleLine1: Serving Abandoned People, Turning Anguish Silently Into New Dawn Horizons... Unceasingly.
hero.desktopDescription: 'Saptasindhu' Mahila Adhar Balsangopan And Shikshan Sanstha founded in 1998 by Padmashri Dr. Sou. Sindhutai Sapakal (Maai), the organization supports orphaned and underprivileged children. Over the years, it has expanded its reach across Maharashtra, providing shelter, education, and emotional support.

journey.title: Shahu, Phule, Ambedkar Award 2019
journey.description: The "Shahu, Phule, Ambedkar Award" is an award by the Govt. of Maharashtra. The award is given to the registered organizations working in various fields of social justice, doing social reforms in the state, and taking Maharashtra forward as a social reformist state.

organisations.title: Sanmati Bal Niketan
descriptionDesktop: Sanmati Bal Niketan, located in Manjari, Dist.: Pune, is an organization dedicated to providing essential support and care to underprivileged children.
The organization's primary focus is to fulfill the basic needs of children, including food, shelter, clothing, education, rehabilitation and giving them a secure atmosphere for self-development.

organisations.title: Gopika Gaai Rakshan Kendra
descriptionDesktop: The dedication and compassion shown by Maai towards both cows and people in need is truly remarkable.

Her legacy lives on through the work being carried out by the institution she founded. The story of Maai's connection with the cows and her journey of overcoming adversity to become a mother to orphans is truly touching.
descriptionMobile: The dedication and compassion shown by Maai towards both cows and people in need is truly remarkable.
Her legacy lives on through the work being carried out by the institution she founded.

aboutHeader.missionText: We are committed to work tirelessly and selflessly for the holistic welfare and upliftment of the orphans, the poor, the needy, the neglected and the underprivileged elements of society, irrespective of caste, religion, creed, or gender, through empowerment and rehabilitation.
aboutHeader.valuesText: We see every sheltered child as a future responsible citizen and strive to provide every opportunity for self-reliance. As representatives of Mai and her institutions, we commit to reaching and helping every weak, neglected, and needy individual.
aboutHeader.mobileMissionText: We are committed to work tirelessly and selflessly for the holistic welfare and upliftment of orphans, the poor and the underprivileged, empowering them to become contributing members of society.
aboutHeader.mobileValuesText: We see every sheltered child as a future responsible citizen and strive to provide opportunities for self-reliance while carrying Mai's spirit of compassion and service forward.

coreValues.title: Love
coreValues.desktopText: Love is the global bond that brings human beings together and creates a society that aspires to touch the skies with its feet firmly grounded. That love is the very foundation of Mai's life-work.
coreValues.mobileText: The foundation of Mai's life-work and the bond that unites humanity.

coreValues.title: Acceptance
coreValues.desktopText: As we walk the path of service, this teaching of Mai's perpetually enlightens our way: there is no bigger agony than that of being rejected, so fully accept the pain that comes your way first, and then strive towards overcoming it.
coreValues.mobileText: Embracing pain and rejection while striving to overcome it.

coreValues.title: Awareness
coreValues.desktopText: Teach us to laugh, dear God, but never let us forget the tears that we shed in the past. Walking with the present, with a firm awareness of our past, prepares us for the future.
coreValues.mobileText: Remembering our past while walking confidently toward the future.

coreValues.title: Trust
coreValues.desktopText: Mai's struggle and her work inspires us to trust ourselves always, to win the trust of others and to never lose it.
coreValues.mobileText: Trusting ourselves and never losing the trust of others.

coreValues.title: Simplicity
coreValues.desktopText: Simplicity is synonymous with Mai's life and work, and it is our duty to maintain its sanctity at all costs.
coreValues.mobileText: Maintaining the purity and simplicity reflected in Mai's life.

coreValues.title: Forgiveness
coreValues.desktopText: Forgiveness will always guide you on your way forward. This belief of Mai's always guides us in the right direction.
coreValues.mobileText: Forgiveness guiding us forward in the right direction.

coreValues.title: Gratitude
coreValues.desktopText: We are, and will forever be grateful to the countless helping hands that we have been blessed with.
coreValues.mobileText: Forever thankful for the helping hands that support us.
